These in-situ formed oxides exhibit excellent thermal stability and contribute to a strong Zener pinning effect, which significantly inhibits grain boundary migration and suppresses the coarsening of Al and Si phases during thermal exposure
The Al2O3 particles play a dual role in stabilizing the microstructure: they effectively pin Al grain boundaries (Zener pinning effect), thereby mitigating grain coarsening
the dense Al2O3 film effectively limits the coarsening of Si particles during high-temperature tensile processes and resists the Ostwald ripening effect
the rigid oxide particles act as effective obstacles to dislocation motion, thereby enhancing the high-temperature mechanical performance of the E-FP alloy
the E-FP alloy benefits from finer grains and a higher volume fraction of oxide dispersoids — both of which typically enhance strength through grain refinement and dispersion strengthening mechanisms
